# uptimekuma_notifications (Data Source)

Lists the notification channels of the authenticated user. Handy for attaching an existing channel to monitors managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach notification channels created outside Terraform to a managed monitor.
data "uptimekuma_notifications" "all" {}

resource "uptimekuma_monitor_http" "web" {
  name = "Web"
  url  = "https://example.com"

  notification_ids = [
    for notification in data.uptimekuma_notifications.all.notifications :
    notification.id if notification.is_default
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `notifications` (Attributes List) The notification channels, ordered by ID. Provider-specific settings are not exposed, because they can contain credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifications))

<a id="nestedatt--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the notification is enabled.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the notification.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is applied to new monitors by default.
- `name` (String) Name of the notification.
- `type` (String) Notification provider identifier.
